purpose: Stand-in for the PhD student's simulink_pdem_output_UDDS.mat (not in the repo). Replace with the original when available.
speed_trace: references/drive_cycles/ftpcol.txt, t <= 1369 s (UDDS = FTP-75 bags 1+2), mph -> m/s, 10 Hz linear interpolation
road_load_model: P = F*v/eta_trac (F*v>0) or F*v*eta_regen (F*v<0), F = m_eff*a + k_drag*v^2 + f_roll
fit_source: references/EMS/Pdem_cycles/simulink_pdem_output_stochastic_V{1,3,5,8,9}.mat (VehicleSpeed vs P_req, 10 Hz), alternating least squares
